_doc: Pinned execution engines. The pipeline verifies every code/formula exercise with exactly these engines, and the player must run the same ones, so an answer that passes here passes there. Bump a version only together with the sandbox dependency and a rerun of selftest.py.

python_asgi.note: FastAPI/Starlette served in-process via httpx.ASGITransport on the Python runner (job.asgi); http_equals tests; sync endpoints run inline (no threads in WASM). Not installed: python-multipart, pyjwt, passlib, aiosqlite. Allowed-syntax gate is advisory (no FastAPI detectors in pysyntax).

flutter.note: Dart 3.13.7; headless `flutter test` only (no device, no network, no platform builds). Material is package:flutter/material.dart (3.50 deprecates it). Package name is `exercise`. Allowed-syntax gate is advisory (no Dart detectors). The player/backend must grade server-side with this exact SDK and template.
